notes.title: 10 days to release!
notes.content: Working to improve the UX per feedback, and fixing bugs as they are found!

notes.title: Thumper Speed ++
notes.content: Noticed that balance changes for factories accidentally slowed thumper output.  Both have been sped back up, although not as much as before.

notes.title: Tutorial update!
notes.content: A lot of small updates and fixes, but the biggest change for this update is the tutorial now includes a couple steps to ensure players understand the core controls.

notes.title: Skybox Texture Update
notes.content: This update adds a nice skybox to gameplay, improving the look and feel of the game quite a bit.  The Main menu background has also been updated to match latest art style changes.

notes.title: Clear Instructions
notes.content:
Saw that people are having issues with some of the controls, specifically that they don't know they can remove buildings by holding the right mouse button.

So I've added some quick control instructions to the side of the new game menu.  Hopefully this helps.  As always join the discord and send me any feedback!

notes.title: Small Graphics Update!
notes.content:
Graphics Update!
New animations added for:
* Projectile Impacts
* Mob Regeneration
* Mob Damage Resistance

A bug was found and fixed for large belt lines.
+Misc fixes around steam achievements.

notes.title: Language Translations Live!
notes.content:
German, Spanish, and Portuguese interface translations are now available!  Italian is expected to be available sometime next week.

Like always let me know via Discord if you see any translation errors including any missing translations.

Have fun!

notes.title: New Game +
notes.content:
The default branch of the play test now has New Game + options as well as difficulty options for new games!

Also, ongoing performance improvements so you can build larger and larger factories.

notes.title: Mobs & Towers are arriving in PlayTest!
notes.content:
Biggest update yet! 

I'm so very excited to share the latest progress on the game!   Been working nights and weekends getting this done for you all.

With this build, lots of things are changing.  Old save files will still work, but I recommend starting new bases, or at least turning off thumpers until you ramp up again, these mobs are no joke!

Mob difficulty now properly escalates as you play.  You won't be able to get by anymore just using the starting tower to get to the end.   There are 6 new and unique towers added to the game for you to try, and each tier of enemies now has special abilities.

[b]Junk Turret -[/b] Aka Improvised Turret.  Will throw literally anything at the enemy, including other Junt Turrets!

[b]Double Barrel - [/b]Shoots proper ammo for high damage at high speeds.

[b]Cannon Turret -[/b] Shoots explosives at targets for area effect damage.

[b]Flame Turret -[/b] Close range, high AOE damage.

[b]Laser Turret -[/b] Targets a chaining and splitting laser at enemies.

[b]Sniper Turret -[/b] Very high damage, piercing shots.

[b]Chaingun Turret -[/b] Very high damage, Very high firing speed.  The challenge is not the enemy, it's keeping this fed with ammo!

All of the above turrets have several ranks of ammo as well, keeping them relevant as the game difficulty progresses.

Lastly, we had to make some tough choices.  We want to support large bases, but in order to do so, we have had to remove multiplayer networking.  Just too many items to sync across server and client.  Hopefully, it will be back someday, but don't expect multiplayer soon.  On the plus side, this has enabled us to implement support for some rather large or even huge base complexes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487415/06a68e2b7e418111750362ef3526453e5ac4b683.png[/img]

I hope you enjoy the game!  Please reach out to us in Discord and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Minor fixes
notes.content:
Just some minor fixes this time:

1. Fixes a menu tooltip bug that would recommend the wrong structure to create something.
2. Fixes a chance for items to suddenly become huge.
3. Increase the velocity of items coming out of coal smelters.
4. Adding a creative mode factory for creative players.

notes.title: Hotfix corner belts
notes.content:
Thanks for reporting the bugs!
This fixes a corner belt failure caused by a previous change.

notes.title: A few bug fixes, and some belt cleanup
notes.content:
This fixes a bug with factories that are building things can can have more things on them (like belts and routers).  There was a bug where belts feeding into the factory would occasionally try to put items on the object being constructed instead of the factory itself.

This release also cleans up how belts and routers interface with buildings.  There should be a lot less mess with feeding items into factories.   Less getting items on the wrong belts and things.

Lastly, a factory that has not had its recipe set yet won't reject incoming items.  So you can set up your belts before setting up your recipes if you wish with less mess.

Like always, let us know on discord if you find any bugs with this release!
And thanks!

notes.title: Hotfix for belt stagger
notes.content: A belt stagger got introduced by a last-minute change that made it past testing.  Should now be fixed.

notes.title: More performance improvements
notes.content: Found some more performance bottlenecks in the rendering of the game.  Larger bases should have much smoother frame rates now.

notes.title: Hotfix for routers after performance update.
notes.content: Performance update broke the router output.  This should fix it.

notes.title: Framerate improvements!
notes.content: This update should only contain performance improvements.  Larger bases should have higher frame rates.  Not really any new features.  If something was broken by this build, reach out to us in the Discord server!

notes.title: Last big update for playtest?
notes.content:
This is the biggest and likely the last big update for the playtest!

There are now 6 tiers of technology and resources, many UI improvements like right-clicking to cancel individual queued items, and displays on buildings to let you know what recipe has been assigned.

Huge thanks to everyone who participated in this playtest and sent me their feedback.  This update brings the factory side of the game very close to our final intentions for early access.  The next step will be to iterate and improve on the tower defense aspect of the game as well as adding polishes like Steam Achievements, ambient sounds, and special effects.

Please continue to play this update for the next week or so and provide your feedback.  Looking forward to getting the full game out to everyone soon!

notes.title: Turret Animation added
notes.content:
Fixed the sliders on sound and music to be easier to use.
Added an animation for arrow turrets so they have some action while shooting at creeps.

notes.title: Main character visual update!
notes.content:
Changes for this build:

1. This build updates the art for the main character and a few other pieces. 
2. There are also a lot of new sounds added to the game.  
3. Tutorial fixes
4. Bug fixes

Enjoy!

notes.title: New Game Art!
notes.content:
Thank you to @saurav_kumar_72 on Discord for working with me to create better art for Automate Defend Repeat.  Up until this point, I've been sole developer and artist for this game, and I'm only decent at one of those two skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44487415/b5aa946d1f299bdd73f88f5c5347cdc1629711c9.png[/img]

The game still has a long ways to go, but I hope you all find it more pleasant to play now. 

Other updates/fixes:
1. Improvements to how routers and junctions work
2. Early prototype of a mini-map in the top left of the game view
3. Bug fixes for tower defense mobs
4. Life bars added to tower defense mobs. 

Still a ways to go, looking forward to your feedback.  Please drop by the discord channel and say hi and let me know what you think of the game.

Thanks,
Josh.
